newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank drains SKK150 mln in rev repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank drains SKK150 mln in rev repo tender.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Friday it drained funds totalling 150 million crowns through a six-day securities reverse repurchase tender.
The NBS said in a statement the average rate was 17.0 percent, after 17.3 percent in Thursday's reverse repo tender with a seven-day maturity.
The NBS added the tender was oversubscribed with 150 million crowns worth of bids from a total of 350 million being accepted.
